notes: Each map is aggregated over its two repeats before the 30 maps are equally weighted.

Rate differences and their bounds are reported in percentage points; the underlying proportions remain in each group summary. Unknown events widen the separate scenario bounds and are never filled as zero.
Scenario bounds express UNKNOWN sensitivity and are not confidence intervals.
Continuous metrics report known-map coverage; scenario bounds are not defined for them.
Completion-time subsets select on success and do not prove overall speed-up.
The legacy composite score is not used for ranking.

report.scope: frozen formal analysis; no composite score; no confirmatory p-values

first_actual_scene_only_sensitivity.note: sensitivity only; first scene start is never replaced by a later substitute
